projects.name: Prime24AI
projects.problem: inquiries and follow-up get handled inconsistently
projects.why_now: a small supervised pilot can validate measurable response handling
projects.workflow: capture one inquiry source, draft a response, approve it, record outcome
projects.baseline_metric: time to first response by source
projects.target_metric: reduce median response time without raising missed urgent inquiries
projects.proof_required: verified intake log and response timestamp

projects.name: ALPHA Agent Force
projects.problem: multi-step work lacks scoped responsibility and audit trail
projects.why_now: a narrow pilot can test repeatable handoffs
projects.workflow: plan a mission, scope a specialist, verify, seek action approval
projects.baseline_metric: completed work and review time in current workflow
projects.target_metric: verified completion rate and review time
projects.proof_required: independent verification with source and event record

projects.name: Learn / Workflow Fieldkit
projects.problem: generic lessons do not transfer into daily work
projects.why_now: job-specific exercises can be tested with a small cohort
projects.workflow: choose a role, complete one guided exercise, review output
projects.baseline_metric: exercise completion and usefulness from a small cohort
projects.approval_boundary: human review of regulated or consequential advice

projects.name: PitchMe
projects.customer: person pitching a service or opportunity
projects.problem: generic pitches fail to show a specific fit
projects.why_now: a short tailored draft can be assessed quickly
projects.workflow: collect facts, produce a grounded pitch draft, review before use
projects.target_metric: increase qualified replies per verified contact
projects.approval_boundary: human checks claims and approves each send

projects.name: Paws & Power
projects.customer: dog owner seeking a shared routine
projects.problem: human and dog routines are hard to coordinate
projects.why_now: a constrained weekly routine can test retention
projects.workflow: collect preferences, suggest a safe general routine, track feedback
projects.baseline_metric: weekly active users and reported fit
projects.approval_boundary: human decides health and animal safety concerns

projects.name: PrimeSignal
projects.problem: monitor alerts lack verified impact and clear communication
projects.why_now: a seeded incident workflow can test evidence handling
projects.workflow: collect a signal, check sources and impact, draft reviewed update
projects.baseline_metric: time from detection to verified impact and false alerts
projects.target_metric: reduce verification time without more false public alerts
projects.proof_required: timestamped source checks and affected segment evidence
projects.approval_boundary: human approves every public incident update

projects.name: BuyerCue
projects.problem: store readiness for agent-led shopping is unclear
projects.why_now: ten-store test can expose actionable gaps
projects.workflow: test a store journey, classify observed friction, propose a fix
projects.baseline_metric: verified issues per store and merchant follow-through
projects.target_metric: more fixes adopted per audited store
projects.proof_required: reproducible store observations and owner confirmation
projects.approval_boundary: merchant approves store or checkout changes

projects.name: ReviewLift
projects.problem: review requests lack clear consent and tracking
projects.why_now: a narrow opt-in workflow can validate demand
projects.workflow: capture consent, draft a request, record response
projects.target_metric: increase completed reviews per consented request
projects.approval_boundary: human approves outbound requests and policy claims

projects.name: MedBill Scout
projects.problem: patients struggle to identify items to question
projects.why_now: a reviewed checklist can test clarity before automation
projects.workflow: extract line items, flag questions, prepare review draft
projects.target_metric: increase useful questions without false certainty
projects.proof_required: original bill line and reviewer confirmation
projects.approval_boundary: human reviews every billing conclusion and letter

projects.name: CredentialFlow AI
projects.problem: enrollment packets and expirations are easy to lose track of
projects.why_now: a single queue can validate process value
projects.workflow: track packet state, missing items, owner and deadlines
projects.baseline_metric: late packets and staff handling time
projects.target_metric: reduce late packets with an auditable owner trail
projects.approval_boundary: authorized staff approve submissions and record changes
